Gaudete Sunday

A Joyful Gaudete Sunday at Home

Gaudete Sunday invites us to relax the penitential tones of Advent and embrace joyful anticipation as Christmas draws near. This agenda offers a warm, practical way to celebrate this special day from the comfort of your home.

  1. Sunrise

    Embrace the Rose Hue

    Begin your day by incorporating rose colors into your home, perhaps with a centerpiece or a lit candle, symbolizing the relaxation of penitential tones and joyful anticipation.

  2. 10:00 am

    Jubilant Hymns and Reflection

    Play uplifting hymns that herald the nearness of Christmas, reflecting on the "Gaudete in Domino" introit that gives this Sunday its name.

  3. 12:00 pm

    Crafting Rosy Delights

    Prepare a batch of rosy macarons, a sweet treat enjoyed by many to celebrate the joyful spirit of Gaudete Sunday.

    Recipes: Rose Raspberry Macarons for Gaudete Sunday

  4. 3:00 pm

    Simmering Sweet Warmth

    Brew a comforting pot of warm fruit punch, a delightful beverage perfect for sharing the festive cheer.

    Recipes: Gaudete Sunday Festive Fruit Punch

  5. 5:00 pm

    A Taste of Simbang Gabi

    Experience a tradition from the Philippines by preparing bibingka and puto bumbong, enjoyed by worshippers during the Simbang Gabi novena.

    Recipes: Bibingka (Traditional Filipino Baked Rice Cake) · Puto Bumbong

  6. 7:00 pm

    Festive Feast and Fellowship

    Gather with loved ones to enjoy the prepared treats, savoring the flavors and the joyful anticipation of Christmas.

  7. Sundown

    Peaceful Anticipation

    Conclude your day with a moment of quiet reflection, embracing the hopeful and joyful spirit that Gaudete Sunday brings as Christmas draws near.

May your Gaudete Sunday be filled with warmth, joy, and the sweet anticipation of the coming Christmas season.
